content: Erancho na7ay ba aawa seera si7ees; shin qelqiseysi seera ekenna.
Asi ba doonape keyiya qaalan lo77oba ekees; shin ammanetonaysati makallaba amottoosona.
Ba doona naagiya uray ba shempuwa naagees;

content.text: shin eeson haasaya uray bana dhaysees.

content: Azallay amottees; amotikonne aybaka demmenna; shin minnidi ootheysati kallana.
Xillo asati wordo oda ixoosona. Shin iita asata odi yeellayeesinne kawushshees.
Suure de7uwa de7iya uraa iya xillotethay naagees; shin nagarancho iya nagaray ongees.
Bana dure daanisiya asi de7ees; shin iyaw aybinne baawa; qassi bana manqo daanisiya asi de7ees; shin iyaw daro aqoy de7ees.
Asi ba miishen ba shempo wozanaw danda7ees; shin manquwa yashisiyabay baawa.
Xillota poo7oy phoolees;
Otoroy ooshshi yelees; shin zore ekeysati cincata.
Daaburi bayna demmida miishey eeson dhayees; shin minni oothidi demmida aqoy, dari daridi bees.
Koyiyabay poletonna gam7eysi azzanthees; shin amotidabay poleteysi ufaysees.
Zore kadhiya uray meton gelees; shin kiita bonchiya uray saro de7ana.
Cincatethi immiya timirtey de7o pulto; higgey ase hayqo xihepe kessi ekanaw maaddees.
Akeeki de7iya uray bonchetees; shin ammanetona ixoy qohos gathees.
Cinca asi ubbay eran oothees; shin eeyi ba eeyatetha qoncisees.
Iita asati kiitetidi, meton geloosona; shin ammanthiya asati kiitetidi, sarotethi ehoosona.
Seera ixiya asi manqeesinne yeellatees;
Amotidabay poleteysi daro ufaysees;
Cinca asara hemetiya asi cinca gidees;

content.text: shin eeya asara hemetiya asi meton gelees.

content: Nagaranchota iita qaaday kaallees;
Lo77o asi ba nayta nayta laatisees;
Manquwa goshshay daro kathi ayfenaw danda7ees;
Pircon seeranaw dosonna asi ba na7aa ixees;

content.text: shin ba na7aa siiqiya uray minnidi seerees.

content: Xilloy, uloy kallana gakanaw mees;
